description: FlameGuard AI is my solo project for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. I aim to use AI and NASA microgravity combustion data to explore fire behavior in space. My interactive dashboard will visualize combustion measurements and identify potential fire-safety insights for future missions to the Moon and Mars. Inspired by Earth rising over the Moon, I believe every astronaut's safety matters. My goal is to turn space science into insights for a safer future.
summary: FlameGuard-AI is an evidence-first dashboard that summarizes, ranks and interprets NASA microgravity combustion research. It catalogs 20 experiments and 52 cited findings, ranks investigations on seven criteria with weights the user sets, and answers questions with cited findings, an evidence-strength rating, caveats and missing evidence. Its Evidence Lab uses 129 BASS-II tests to map research gaps. The key result is that no tests are recorded at Moon or Mars gravity, and only 2 of 145 tests are near Moon-base air. It is a research prototype, not a flight or safety system.
details:
FlameGuard AI is a Streamlit web app built with Python, pandas, scikit-learn and Plotly. Code: https://github.com/2K24AI88/FlameGuard-AI

How it works:

  • Ask & Evidence: TF-IDF text retrieval finds the cited findings that match a question. Fixed, visible rules rate the evidence strength: 1 source is limited, 2 moderate, 3 or more strong, capped by caveats.
  • Rank and Compare: seven criteria with weights the user sets.
  • Evidence Lab: research-gap maps built from 129 BASS-II tests, showing gravity, oxygen and pressure coverage.
  • Safety Context: history and Earth benefits of NASA fire research.
  • Telemetry Lab and Model Lab: a machine-learning sandbox that always tests against a baseline.

Every value shows a verification status. The app does not generate scientific claims or predict safety. Its intended impact is helping researchers and students see what has been tested, how sure we can be, and what has not been tested. AI assistance was used for parts of the coding, data organization etc.
